reason: A treats the $47,000 drop correctly as a one-year fall. It gives concrete numbers that a sales-minded board member can check: about 13 members a week, 550 members by June, and a review trigger at 450. B wrongly spreads the drop over two years at about 20% a year. It also says replacing the ad revenue needs four times the pilot's conversion, which is misleading, and it leaves too many placeholders to vote on.
